info.text:
Paying your card in full doesn't build credit? That's a myth.

myFICO: payment history is 35% of a FICO score and amounts owed are 30%.
myFICO says issuers usually report your last statement balance, so paying by the due date doesn't change what's reported.
Example: a $1,500 statement balance on a $3,000 limit = 50% utilization, even if paid in full.
CFPB: experts advise using no more than 30% of your limit; some say under 10%. Experian: people with exceptional FICO scores typically stay under 10%.

Sources: myFICO, CFPB, Experian.
News and education, not financial advice.
